annotations.title: Link a development branch to a GitHub issue

description: Create a branch on GitHub linked to an issue (its Development panel), or return the linked branch that exists already. It goes through the API: nothing is fetched or checked out locally. With branch, a linked branch of that name is reused; without it, the first linked branch in the branch repository. A new branch starts from base (it must exist) or the default branch. A pull request opened from a linked branch closes the issue when it merges, with no closing keyword; use a plain branch when the first merge should not close it.

base.description: The branch to start from, which must exist; defaults to the branch repository's default branch.

branch.description: The branch name; when left out, a linked branch in the branch repository is reused, else GitHub names one.

branch_repo.description: owner/name of the repository to create the branch in; defaults to the issue's repository.

issue.description: The issue, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_issue_develop

base.description: The branch it was started from; null for a branch that already existed.

branch_repo.description: owner/name of the repository that holds the branch.

created.description: False when a linked branch already existed and nothing was sent.

linked_branches.description: Every branch linked to the issue now.

repo.description: owner/name of the repository that holds the branch.
